colors.name: ink
colors.role: ground — deep terminal black with a faint green tint; the unlit console every waveform is drawn against

colors.name: phosphor
colors.role: primary text, spectrum bars, cursor, focus ring — the live signal (11.16:1 on ink, AAA)

colors.name: phosphor-dim
colors.role: secondary text — axis labels, episode meta, the calm readout under the bars (4.75:1 on ink, AA normal)

colors.name: soft-white
colors.role: episode titles, headings, peak values — the readable headline copy (16.72:1 on ink, AAA)

colors.name: amber
colors.role: the one warning hue — overload peaks that clip the ceiling, and trend deltas that fell (11.65:1 on ink, AAA)

colors.name: mute
colors.role: tertiary text — timestamps, the marquee separ, low-magnitude readouts (5.20:1 on ink, AA normal)

colors.name: grid
colors.role: decorative only — the spectrum baseline, panel rules, the faint LED grid behind the bars (1.41:1 on ink, never functional text)

fonts.role: the data voice — Latin display, body, the spectrum axis, tabular numbers, the marquee ticker; a code/grotesque monospace, deliberately distinct from PALE.SIGNAL's VT323 CRT face and GLITCH's Space Mono

every Hangul glyph — a clean modern grotesque set on the JetBrains rhythm via :lang(ko). D2Coding is the ideal Korean mono but is not on Google Fonts; Noto Sans KR keeps Korean first-class and ships via next/font without a self-host payload

texture: A single fixed, pointer-transparent overlay above the content: faint horizontal scanlines (1px of rgba(74,222,128,0.045) every 3px — a calm terminal grille, lighter than GLITCH's datamosh shimmer) plus a soft vignette. No noise grain, no RGB split — WAVE is a working dashboard, not a broken or reverent one. The spectrum bars carry all the motion; the glass stays nearly still. All overlay motion is removed under prefers-reduced-motion and the page becomes a composed static frame (spectrum frozen at a mid-range frame).

motion.name: ease-soft
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) — reveals and fades: fast, long tail

motion.name: spectrum-rise
motion.value: rAF loop, ~60fps, each bar's height eased toward a per-band target with attack 0.18 / release 0.08 (60fps-normalized); pauses offscreen and on hidden tabs

motion.name: typewriter-cadence
motion.value: 32ms per char + 0–22ms jitter, 220ms line pause; any input completes it instantly

motion.name: marquee-scroll
motion.value: translateX 0 → -50% over 34s linear infinite (the duplicated track makes the loop seamless); under 0.03Hz, photosafe; pauses offscreen

motion.name: cursor-blink
motion.value: 1.06s steps(2, jump-none) — the block cursor; below 1Hz, photosafe

motion.name: scan-breathe
motion.value: scanline overlay opacity 0.9 → 1.0 over 11.2s ease-in-out infinite (under 0.1Hz) — the only ambient motion on the glass

motion.name: reveal-fade
motion.value: 520ms ease-soft, opacity 0→1 + translateY(12px)→0, 80ms stagger per observer batch
